# ADR-019: Retain source controller and collision forces in the existing ball metadata

Status: chosen_for_partial_force_history

Concerns: Q-state, Q-behavior, Q-evidence

## Decision

Generate one Forces value in each existing ball metadata owner, with lossless binary64 logical snapshot representation. Reset on actual live/free control admission, retain computed controller output, project real forces for all collision candidates and commit solver mutations including dead neighbours. Remove the redundant PreparedMotion acceleration field.

## Rationale

Original skips force reset for dead bodies; their retained force can change another live body prediction. The actual failing headless comparison exposed zeroed scratch inputs. Both source response kernels already contained the force arithmetic and are reused.

## Alternatives

Zeroed candidate defaults, a second force map, copied collision algorithms or a bounded projection as the runtime owner.

## Consequences

A 3D unchanged-C++ corpus and actual runtime snapshots/replay checks exercise the new data flow. Full collision locations/last-collision/callback histories, dynamic orientation and mandatory core proofs remain incomplete. Old logical snapshots default the newly represented fields to zero.
